description.value: AM Cafe is a 100% plant-based, order-at-the-counter café in the heart of Mount Pleasant, founded by chef Lindsay Loudon whose background spans yacht kitchens and high-end corporate events. The menu leans into plant-based comfort food built to surprise — dishes like the Rogue Waffle and the Faux-Let O' Fish Burger regularly prompt the reaction 'This isn't chicken?' It is a community-focused neighbourhood spot with a relaxed, settle-in atmosphere built around the philosophy of a few ingredients done extremely well.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms AM Cafe is an active, 100% plant-based café at 2528 Guelph Street, Vancouver BC V5T 3P5, matching OSM address, phone (604 336 4767), and name. The OSM tag diet:vegan=only is directly corroborated by the website's '100% Plant Based Café' branding and all-plant menu. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: Website subpages (/menu, /contact, /plant-based-lunch-menu, /drinks-menu, /plant-based-cafe-events) all returned the same homepage content, suggesting the site relies heavily on JavaScript rendering; specific menu item details were not captured.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible café in Vancouver with a live website, confirmed address, and operating hours. Useful stop for cycling tourists, especially those seeking vegan food options.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states '100% Plant Based Café' and all menu items are plant-based. GF options not mentioned
